title: Why coke zero has no sugar but still sweet?

cards.prompt: Why is Coke Zero sweet despite having no sugar?
cards.answer: It uses artificial sweeteners (aspartame and acesulfame potassium).
A hormone that regulates blood sugar and lets it be absorbed into energy.

cards.prompt: Explain like I'm 10: why do diabetics have blood sugar problems?
cards.answer: Their bodies don't make enough insulin or can't use it well. Insulin is what lets sugar go from blood into cells for energy.

cards.prompt: Which is NOT an artificial sweetener?
Artificial sweeteners taste sweet but don't raise blood sugar.
cards.answer: Fact: they only taste sweet and do not increase blood sugar.
